rationale: wu_2015_trainable-claude-agentic: wu_n_bands=8, wu_n_outer=2, wu_motion_range=8, wu_motion_window=2, epochs=12, batch_size=1, lr=0.00011, weight_decay=0.0, loss_base=mse, lambda_neg=0.7, wu_soft_thresh=0.0015, wu_sigmoid_slope=10.0, wu_sigmoid_offset=1.0, wu_band_scale=1.0, wu_residual_blend=1.0, train_n=600, val_n=200, val_chunk=4, seed=42, rationale=ITER-2 (one knob vs iter-1). iter-1 = TPE-winner seed: hr=0.3009 val_ssim=0.9501 psnr=39.43 12 params 819s (~13.7min, fits 20-min budget), status=keep -- reproduces the prior-split ceiling ~0.317 on the new 200-case val. FAILURE MODE: hr pinned at the classical algorithms 4-6-band spectral-expressivity ceiling; the prior TPE lifted hr by moving n_bands 4->6 (+50pct) and the solver design doc lists n_bands=8 (Wagners published value) as the untested lever #4 for finer spectral control. ONE KNOB: wu_n_bands 6 -> 8 (params 12 -> 14, still ultra-low). All else identical to iter-1. HYPOTHESIS: if I raise wu_n_bands to 8 I expect val hr to rise above 0.3009 because 8 triangular radial-frequency bands give the learnable per-band scales finer control to reweight the aliasing-free FBP, matching Wagners recommended band count; risk is +2 params overfit or the extra high-freq bands collapsing (band-runaway) -- watched via per-epoch band_scale log. Budget: +2 bands ~= +1/3 back-projection work in the FBP loop, still well under 20 min.
